statement: One lab in West Jakarta, where circuits get measured, practicums get built, and grading gets automated down from hours to minutes.
body: Electrical engineering student at ITPLN (3.86/4.00), laboratory assistant and full-stack developer at the Smart Electronic Systems Laboratory. I build the practicum platforms students use every cycle, and the RAG/BERT grading system that reads over a hundred answers per session.

facts.title: Measure first
facts.text: Circuit analysis and simulation in Multisim NI and Proteus before anything is built or claimed.

facts.title: Automate the boring
facts.text: Manual grading cut by 60–70%, turnaround from hours to under 10 minutes per session.

facts.title: Ship to a client
facts.text: Production websites with real deployment, real payment integration and real users.
